info.description: Open-weight image model built on H3 for text-to-image generation, reference-based generation, and image editing, with up to 16 reference images and output area up to 20,000,000 pixels. The recorded price is text input and image output per million tokens; image input is $1.50 (¥10).

zh.description: 基于 H3 的开放权重图像模型，支持文生图、参考图生成和图像编辑，最多 16 张参考图，输出面积最大 20,000,000 像素。记录的价格是每百万 tokens 的文本输入与图像输出；图像输入为 1.50 美元（10 元）。
